verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents batch processing of many URLs with per-pattern strategies in one batch (gh-10) and parallel crawling (docs-7). It also supports bulk deep crawls via the CLI with page limits (gh-2), checkpoint and resume for long-running crawls (gh-8, gh-30), and faster bulk URL discovery (gh-31). missing for 10: a concrete batch API code example or in-depth docs on multi-URL concurrency and rate-limit controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk runs at scale.
